Publish.LongDescription:
## ❤️ Bikes + Paths is retired
Thank you for using this mod! Its features are now in **[Adjust All Speed Limits (ASL)](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/149990/Windows)**, with a more advanced in-city panel for bike and pedestrian paths, separate bicycle and scooter speed tuning, and personal vehicle stats.
### Moving to ASL - Before switching, load your city with B+P alone, use **Game defaults**, let the changes finish and save your city. This helps restore legacy path changes, including hidden vehicle pathways. - Remove B+P, install ASL 1.3.0 or newer, and set your desired speeds. 2.00 in B+P = 200% in ASL. - B+P 1.1.6 automatically leaves overlapping speed tuning to ASL. Existing standalone tuning/reset controls remain available for migration when ASL does not manage them. - The old status and debug controls have moved to ASL. This mod remains available for the transition.
Thank you, River-mochi
